name: eHand-6
summary: eHand-6 is HITBOT's six-degree-of-freedom robotic hand for coordinated grasping, pinching and gesture control. Its transmission combines coreless motors, planetary reducers, screws and linkages. The manufacturer specifies CAN FD communication, 24 V operation and a mass below 800 g. Optional five-channel tactile feedback supports contact-aware manipulation, while complex gestures are stated to take no more than 1.1 seconds. The official table distinguishes a 10 N maximum finger gripping force from a 5 kg pulling load, rather than treating them as the same lifting capability.
